protocol.name: Frozen external January 2026 evaluation
protocol.selection: All original 30 training-selected stations; all 744 hours; no reselection by new activity or outcome
protocol.training: Existing fitted pipelines trained/refitted on Jan-Oct 2025; no fit, tuning, recalibration or model selection on new data
protocol.initial_history: Final 168 hours of original recorded-count panel; January rolling one-step features use only preceding known completed-ride counts
protocol.boundary: Include deduplicated December-origin cleaned trips arriving after January start; clean January selected-endpoint records with original rules; count endpoints independently in local-January window
protocol.uncertainty: Paired local-day differences of MAE, 1000 bootstrap resamples seed2025; full-period and fixed weekday/weekend/peak strata
protocol.retention: Retain all model outcomes, including unfavorable cross-year shifts; do not replace old baseline or retune
protocol.scope: First evaluation of this new archived month in this project; public protocol frozen in Git before downloading target records, not a claim of formal trial preregistration or prospective online deployment

rolling_protocol: One-step archived-count forecasting; prior January observations become available only for subsequent-hour lags
operating_state: No January operating calendar inferred; zero means no retained completed record, not proven station operation or latent zero demand
